en: Colorized historic postcard showing a mosque complex with surrounding stone walls and a tall, slender minaret whose top appears damaged or truncated. In the foreground are a rough, open field and two horses or mules with a person, with a large tree near the wall. The sky is blue and lightly clouded. Printed captions in French and English at the top left read "SALONIQUE – Minaret coupé par un obus bulgare" and "SALONICA – A Mosque cut by a shot." At the bottom right is a printed website watermark "www.elia.org.gr."
